player_prompt.intro:
Ati Player {player_id} ti. Tamsaasa Memory Game tamsaasa jirta.
Mee kaardii waliin walitti bu'uu dhabanii guddaa dharaa, kan dura tamsaasa keessan.
Guddinni keessan, kaardii lama fudhachuun barbaachiisu, gara row fi column namni lamaa'uu, sabaabuu '[0 1 1 0]', kaardi lama dura row 0 fi column 1, kaardi lama booda row 1 fi column 0.
Kaardii lama yoo waliin bu'ani, pointi tokko argatta, kaardii waliin bu'ani. Yoo waliin hin bu'in, kaardii fudhachuu hin dhabne, e.g. '.'.
Tamsaasaan itti fufu'e yoo kaardii waliin bu'u hundi waliin bu'e

invalid_move.wrong_format: Taphachiisaa {player_id} kallattii sirrii hin taaneen deebii kenne.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Taphattuun {player_id} dirree daangaa ala ta'e filate.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Taphachiisaa {player_id} kaardii walfakkaataa si'a lama filate.
invalid_move.already_matched: Gochi kee sirrii miti. Player {player_id} kaardii tokko yookiin lamaan wal-qabataman filate.

game_message.cards_match: Kaardiin Player {player_id} bakka [{r1} {c1}] fi [{r2} {c2}] irratti filataman wal-qabatu!
game_message.cards_no_match: Kaardiin Player {player_id} filataman wal-qabatuu hin danda'an. Kaardiin bakka [{r1} {c1}] fi [{r2} {c2}] irratti argaman {pos1} fi {pos2} dha.

outcome.draw: Taphattoonni lamaanuu kaardii lakkoofsa walfakkaatu qabu.
outcome.turn_limit: Dhimmama gochi xumurame. Taphi suni xumurame. Player 0 poyintii {score_0} argate, Player 1 poyintii {score_1} argate.
